summary: CareTrust REIT filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a 17,000,000-share common stock offering executed through separate forward sale agreements with Bank of America, N.A. and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC (or affiliates) as forward purchasers. No price, discount or net proceeds are stated; the last sale price on the NYSE was $38.84 as of November 10, 2026, and an underwriters' option covers up to 19,550,000 shares. The company expects to physically settle within about one year and initially receives no proceeds. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; the arbitrage angle is forward-settlement dilution timing versus acquisition deployment.
